title: MAD Phase Transitions in the Oriented Chromatic Number
summary: For an oriented graph $G$ the oriented chromatic number of $G$, written $χ_o(G)$, is the least integer $t$ such that $G$ has a homomorphism to a tournament on $t$ vertices. The oriented chromatic number of a simple graph $H$ is the maximum oriented chromatic number over all orientations of $H$. Borodin, Kostochka, Ne{š}et{ř}il, Raspaud, and Sopena proved in 1999 that for all $ε>0$, graphs with maximum average degree less than $4-ε$ have bounded oriented chromatic number.
